verdict.rationale: Northwest Registered Agent is a registered-agent and business-filing service, which could plausibly offer webhooks for events like received documents or filing status changes, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented outbound HTTP callbacks of any kind. The site's robots.txt returned a Cloudflare challenge and no first-party docs were fetched; the only community item comments on the company's SEO, which says nothing about webhooks.
